label: Nextdoor
terms_note: Community Guidelines: local relevance, businesses post from a Business Page, no spam. Body <=8,192 chars, <=10 attachments, media URLs must be public.

capabilities: post(neighbor / business / agency / event / for-sale posts)

auth: 1. Submit the **Publishing API request form** (or Displaying API form); "every application is reviewed individually
2. Approved apps receive a client id + secret → access token (OAuth 2.0; scopes listed per endpoint, e.g. post
3. Posts can be made from a **neighbor profile or a Business Page** (`profile_id`).

endpoints.call: POST /external/api/partner/v1/post/create/` {body_text (≤ 8,192 chars), media_attachments[≤ 10 public URLs], smartlink (URL preview), hashtag (no spaces), lat, lon, profile_id} → {result, share_link h
Search API, Trending Posts API, Public Agency Feed API (Displaying access)

reference.limits: - Body 8,192 characters, 10 attachments; media / smartlink URLs must be public. - Access is case-by-case; Nextdoor Community Guidelines (local relevance; businesses post from a Business Page; no spam). Rate limits not stated on the pages read.

fields.name: access_token
fields.help: Publish API user access token: apply for access (Nextdoor Partnerships issue client_id / client_secret), send the user through https://www.nextdoor.com/v3/authorize/ with scopes openid post:write post:read comment:write profile:read, then exchange the code at POST https://auth.nextdoor.com/v2/token (https://developer.nextdoor.com/reference/sharing-get-access-token; expires_in 31536000 s in the documented example). Refresh it before expiry (https://developer.nextdoor.com/reference/sharing-refresh-access-token). Sent as 'Authorization: Bearer <access_token>'.

config_fields.name: secure_profile_id
config_fields.help: Optional profile id from GET /me/profiles (https://developer.nextdoor.com/reference/me-copy) to post / delete as a business or other profile of the account instead of the default neighbor profile.

adapter.terms: Community Guidelines apply (local relevance, businesses post from a Business Page, no spam); body text up to 8,192 characters, up to 10 publicly accessible media URLs.

me.note: GET /external/api/partner/v1/me/ (profile:read) returns {id, first_name, last_name, status, verified, is_business_profile, neighborhood_name, city_name, business_name, ...}.

publish_text.note: PUBLISHES a post to the user's Nextdoor neighborhood (or to the business / entity page of config secure_profile_id): POST /post/create/ {body_text (max 8,192 characters)} (post:write) answers {result: 'success', share_link: 'https://nextdoor.com/p/{post_share_id}'}. The API returns no separate id, so `id` and `url` are both the share_link (its last path segment is the post_share_id). `reply_to` is ignored.

publish_image.note: PUBLISHES a post with media_attachments = image_urls ('The limit is 10 attachments'; every URL must be valid and publicly accessible). body_text is REQUIRED by Nextdoor, so pass `text` (a post without it is rejected with 400). `id` / `url` are the returned share_link.

delete.note: DESTRUCTIVE: DELETE /post/?id= 'Deletes your post on Nextdoor that matches the post id provided' (post:write) and answers {message: 'Post deleted successfully'}. `post_id` is the post id as listed by GET /post/ (Get your posts, https://developer.nextdoor.com/reference/get-your-posts).

not_offered.read_comments: No per-post comments endpoint exists: comments come embedded in 'Get your posts' (GET /post/, the most recent posts of the account, https://developer.nextdoor.com/reference/get-your-posts), which cannot be addressed by post id.
not_offered.reply_comment: POST /comment/ requires the post's share id (`id`) in addition to parent_comment_id (https://developer.nextdoor.com/reference/create-comment-to-a-post-create-reply-to-a-comment); a comment id alone cannot address the reply.
not_offered.read_mentions: The Publish API has no mentions or notifications endpoint (https://developer.nextdoor.com/reference/get-your-posts lists only your own posts).
not_offered.analytics_post: view_count and smartlink_click_count are only fields of the recent-posts list GET /post/ (https://developer.nextdoor.com/reference/get-your-posts), not retrievable by post id; business and entity pages are 'not supported at the moment' there.

evidence: probe: 4/4 tools answered on their documented path with an auth refusal, a validation error or data; control route answered 401 too, so the host authenticates before routing
HTML docs spot-check (render-doc): 1/1 tool paths found verbatim on their docs pages; every parameter and body key named on the page
